trialUnit: one measured burst on a fresh GitHub-hosted runner and fresh four-orderer BFT deployment
pilotUse: retained separately; never pooled into this preregistered cohort
failurePolicy: retain failed trials and all warm-up/request logs; no success-only trial selection
analysis: sample SD and two-sided 95% Student-t CI across 50 independent-deployment trial means
limitations: single small synthetic image and fixed code project
not production workload fidelity or full concurrency sweep
